webDomains.requestTransferReason2: Needing more control over your DNS settings than this Control Panel is currently able to offer
webDomains.requestTransferWarning: By transferring domains, we are no longer able to automatically update the DNS settings accordingly. If there is any change in our servers requiring DNS record updates, you'll have to follow those announcements and be able to update your DNS records accordingly.
webDomains.requestTransferDocs: To find out what DNS host records you need to have, please visit our documentation
webDomains.selfManageDesc: Self managing your domain means that you register your domain yourself and manage your DNS settings yourself. Reasons you might want to do this include:
webDomains.selfManageReason1: Wanting to discontinue use of the Control Panel
webDomains.selfManageReason2: Needing more control over your DNS settings than this Control Panel is currently able to offer
webDomains.selfManageReason3: Not being able to transfer your domain to the Control Panel for technical reasons
webDomains.selfManageWarning: By self managing your domain, we are no longer able to automatically update the DNS settings accordingly. If there is any change in our servers requiring DNS record updates, you'll have to follow those announcements and be able to update your DNS records accordingly.
webDomains.selfManageDocs: To find out what DNS host records you need to have, please visit our documentation
webDomains.transferInConfirm: Are you sure you want to transfer {name} to the Control Panel?
webDomains.transferInEppDesc: All you need is your EPP/Auth code and we'll take care of transferring your domain immediately

domainReadiness.title: Before you switch this domain's DNS
domainReadiness.intro: Switching the DNS of {domain} to this server moves every address on it at once. Everyone whose email is on it gets a mailbox automatically when it goes live. Check this first.
domainReadiness.enableIntro: Everyone whose email is on this domain is switched over automatically once it goes live, so their mail keeps arriving. It's the address they already have, so nothing changes for them. Their sign-in address will no longer be somewhere a password reset can reach them, so a secondary recovery email matters. You can cancel now and come back once more people have added one.
domainReadiness.loading: Checking who is on this domain...
domainReadiness.nobody: Nobody has an email on this domain yet, so nobody needs switching over.
domainReadiness.switching: {count} users with an email on this domain will be switched over automatically.
domainReadiness.secondaryCounts: {with_count} of them have a secondary recovery email. {without_count} don't.
domainReadiness.withoutSecondaryHelp: Ask them to add one from their profile. It can't be an address on this domain.
domainReadiness.cannotSwitch: {count} users with an email on this domain can't be switched over automatically. Their mail would bounce after the DNS moves.

settings.currencyDescription: Set the billing currencies supported for plan pricing. The default currency is used when an organization has no currency set.

stripeWebhook.title: Stripe Webhook Setup
stripeWebhook.about: Stripe uses a webhook to tell KumuliCP about payment and subscription changes, such as a failed payment or a cancelled subscription. KumuliCP uses these events to keep each organization's status up to date.
stripeWebhook.secretMissing: No webhook signing secret is configured (STRIPE_WEBHOOK_SECRET), so incoming requests are not verified as coming from Stripe.

settings.captchaDescription: Add CAPTCHA protection to the self-registration form to prevent spam and automated submissions.
settings.selfRegistrationDescription: When enabled, organization admins can share a registration link that allows new users to sign up and join their organization directly, without needing an admin to create their account manually.
settings.securityToolsDescription: Each security scan tool runs from a pinned, known-good image version by default. You can override the image tag used for a tool below.
settings.securityToolsWarning: Overriding the default version is usually safe, but you are responsible for verifying the image you specify. Untrusted or unverified tags (including "latest") can introduce supply-chain risk. Use a custom version at your own risk.
settings.featuresDescription: Turn major parts of the control panel on or off. A feature that is off is hidden from the menus and its pages cannot be reached.
settings.featuresEnvNote: Starting values come from the TOGGLE_* environment variables. Once saved here, the value in the control panel is used instead of the environment variable.
settings.betaWarning: Features marked Beta are still being finished. They may change, have rough edges, and are not recommended for production data yet.

systemChecks.ldapModelValidationDescription: Scans every entry in the LDAP directory to make sure it satisfies the required object classes of one of the application's LDAP models (User, EmailUser, Group, etc.). Entries that don't fit any model fall back to a generic entry type, which can cause errors when the application expects a specific model.
